summary: PIM Manager never removes an assignment you did not ask to remove, and naming and licences are fully in your hands.

new.title: Register your licence in Settings
new.text: Settings > Licence has Register a licence: pick the file or paste its contents. A file that does not verify is refused and nothing is stored.

new.title: Name admin accounts your way
new.text: Settings > Naming has an admin word and a tenant short name, so one pattern serves every tenant. PIM Manager now always recognises its own admin accounts.

new.title: Pick the admin account domain
new.text: Settings > Admin account domain now lists your verified domains, shows how many were found and offers Re-read when the list is empty.

new.title: Copy button in the run log
new.text: The run log has a Copy button that copies the whole log, and Live tail explains itself.

fixes.title: Eligible and Active can coexist
fixes.text: Before, asking for one assignment type replaced the other. PIM Manager now creates what a row asks for and leaves the rest alone.
fixes.action: If a row asks for a type that is not live, the first run creates it; mark the one you do not want for removal and commit.

fixes.title: No changes from an incomplete read
fixes.text: When reading your tenant fails part-way, that area is now left untouched for the run instead of being planned from partial data.

fixes.title: Committed removals are never dropped
fixes.text: A removal whose target could not be seen is now kept and retried, instead of being treated as done.

fixes.title: Naming is never guessed
fixes.text: If your naming settings are missing, PIM Manager stops and names the missing setting instead of falling back to defaults that would rename accounts.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: The removal-blocked mail is rewritten in plain words, licence and edition checks are corrected, and options that cannot work on a single tenant are locked off.
